title: Tahir Hussain convicted in 2020 Delhi riots case; 12 others acquitted
description:
A court here on Saturday convicted former AAP councillor Tahir Hussain in a case related to the 2020 northeast Delhi riots in the Dayalpur area, while acquitting the 12 other accused.
Additional Sessions Judge Praveen Singh convicted Hussain under Indian Penal Code (IPC) Section 147 (punishment for rioting) read with Section 109 (Punishment of abetment if the act abetted is committed in consequence and where no express provision is made for its punishment).
The court listed the matter for hearing arguments on quantum of sentence on November 16.
The 13 accused in the case included Hussain, Mohammad Shadab, Shah Alam, Riyasat Ali, Gulfam, Rashid, Mohammad Rihan, Mohammad Abid, Arshad Qayyum, Irshad Ahmed, Deepak Singh Saini, Navneet and Mehak Singh.
They were accused of rioting, theft in a dwelling house, mischief by fire or explosive substances, among other offences.
In July, a Delhi court convicted Hussain and four others in the case related to the killing of Intelligence Bureau .
